content.short: BlockBee is a non-custodial crypto payment gateway with instant payouts for merchants.
content.description: BlockBee lets businesses accept and send payments in many cryptocurrencies through a non-custodial platform with instant payouts, no setup or monthly fees, and transaction fees from 0.25%. It serves thousands of merchants. Stable's official ecosystem page lists BlockBee.
content.meta: BlockBee is a non-custodial crypto payment gateway with instant payouts, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
